mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a transverse wave that can travel vertically and horizontally and can not pass through fluids."
S- Wave is a transverse wave that can travel vertically and horizontally and can not pass through fluids.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the measure of how much of the magnetism will be retained having removed the magnetising field."
Susceptibility is the measure of how much of the magnetism will be retained having removed the magnetising field.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a longitudinal wave that can pass through liquid, solid and gas."
P- Wave is a longitudinal wave that can pass through liquid, solid and gas.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the difference between the theoretical and the observed gravity values after all necessary corrections."
The gravity anomaly is the difference between the theoretical and the observed gravity values after all necessary corrections.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called body waves because they can pass through the earth's interior."
P and S- waves are called body waves because they can pass through the earth's interior.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a space within a given volume of solid rock that is not occupied by the solid constituents."
Pore Space in Rocks Pore space is a space within a given volume of solid rock that is not occupied by the solid constituents.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the residual field that remains in the body when the magnetising field has reduced to zero."
Remanent magnetisation is the residual field that remains in the body when the magnetising field has reduced to zero.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ratio of the volume of the fluid to the whole pore volume containing the fluid the fluid in the rock considered."
Pore saturation of a fluid is the ratio of the volume of the fluid to the whole pore volume containing the fluid the fluid in the rock considered.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the gravity change caused by attraction of sun and moon on the earth."
Tidal Correction Tidal effect is the gravity change caused by attraction of sun and moon on the earth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are made up of induced magnetisation from the earth's field and that from remanent magnetisation."
Total magnetisation in rocks are made up of induced magnetisation from the earth's field and that from remanent magnetisation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the important parameters in the area of magnetic prospecting."
Susceptibility and permeability are the important parameters in the area of magnetic prospecting.

pore spaces

minerals

Magnetometer
Magnetometer is a major instrument for magnetic prospecting.
______ are used to depict the characteristics of magnetism around a permanent magnet.
Flux lines
Flux lines are used to depict the characteristics of magnetism around a permanent magnet.

Volume fraction of a component
Volume fraction of a component is the ratio of the volume of the component to the total volume (bulk volume) of the rock.
